articles.title: Police to examine Thomas Markle's digital devices after child sex abuse image claims
articles.summary: Police in the Philippines have been handed a warrant by a court to start examining digital material alleged to contain child sex abuse images belonging to the Duchess of Sussex's father, Thomas Markle Snr.

articles.title: Could she stand? Lagarde quits European Central Bank ahead of French election
articles.summary: The French head of the European Central Bank (ECB) is to step down from the role, just months ahead of the troubled country's presidential election.

articles.title: North Korea fires ballistic missiles off east coast as tensions with South rise
articles.summary: North Korea has launched ballistic missiles off its east coast into the Sea of Japan, South Korea said on Thursday, as tensions continued to rise between the two countries.

articles.title: Girl injured in wolf attack at wildlife park
articles.summary: An eight-year-old girl has been seriously injured in a wolf attack at a wildlife park in Germany.

articles.title: US makes interest rate decision - as Bank of England verdict looms
articles.summary: The Federal Reserve has left interest rates unchanged - despite persistently high inflation and repeated calls from Donald Trump to lower borrowing costs.

articles.title: Defiant Bolsonaro breaks silence after fleeing Brazil for the US
articles.summary: Flavio Bolsonaro has called himself the "leader of Brazil" - despite losing the presidential election.

articles.title: Cruise ship left stranded in Cambodia after 'soaring fuel costs'
articles.summary: A luxury cruise ship on a three-year, round-the-world voyage has been forced to suspend the trip in Cambodia due to rising fuel costs, operators have said.

articles.title: Knife attacker shot dead by police outside Israeli embassy
articles.summary: A man carrying knives has been killed by police after attacking an officer outside the Israeli embassy in Belgrade.

articles.title: Zookeeper dies after leopard attack
articles.summary: A woman has died after being attacked by a leopard at the safari park where she spent almost her entire 40-year career.
